meta.provenance_footer: Illustrative scenario. Well logs are high-resolution synthetic data generated from petrophysical and geomechanical models (Archie, Wyllie, Eaton) calibrated to this scenario; drilling, mud-log and chemistry channels, offset reports & SOPs are simulated. Plug-in to ONGC data = pilot scope.
